data.body:
Deterministic-rule matrix (defaults to calibrate on the local corpus; protected spans are identifiers, paths, commands, dates, measurements, decisions, constraints, blockers, and exact error text):

- Exact duplication — Signal: case/whitespace/list-marker-normalized prose unit of at least 8 words repeats. Threshold: flag any repeat; block if one unit occurs at least 3 times or duplicates comprise at least 15% of unprotected prose. Severity: advisory below the block threshold, blocking above it. Exempt: headings, table headers, checklist markers, code, logs, and versioned normative quotations.
- Near/cross-history duplication — Signal: two units of at least 20 words, or a comment versus the description/last five comments, have token 5-shingle Jaccard at least 0.80. Threshold: one pair. Severity: advisory only. Exempt: test matrices or acceptance criteria with distinct protected facts; typed correction, resolution, or handoff records.
- Transcript dump — Signal: at least 20 consecutive shell/log/JSON-like lines, or at least 2,000 transcript characters comprising over 25% of the artifact. Threshold: warn there; block above 50 lines or 4,000 characters when no at-most-100-word finding summary plus durable pointer/hash exists. Severity: advisory then blocking. Exempt: session logs and exact bug/security/incident evidence; those remain linked or attached rather than copied into the plan.
- Structurally empty update — Signal: a comment has no non-empty Delta, Evidence, Decision, Blocker, or Next field and fewer than 8 content words with no identifier, metric, link, or command. Threshold: one comment. Severity: blocking. Exempt: machine-typed lifecycle events and monitoring heartbeats.
- Filler/meta narration — Signal: configurable stock phrases such as “certainly,” “here is,” “it is important to note,” “as mentioned above,” or “in conclusion.” Threshold: at least 3 matches or over 2 per 100 prose words. Severity: advisory. Exempt: quotations and user-facing copy under review.
- Paragraph/sentence sprawl — Signal: sentence over 45 words or prose paragraph over 120 words. Threshold: one occurrence. Severity: informational/advisory only. Exempt: code, exact errors, logs, legal text, and quotations.
- Alternative/hedge sprawl — Signal: at least 3 Option/Alternative blocks or more than 3 hedge terms per 100 words. Threshold: one breach; for an executable plan, more than one mutually exclusive path without a Chosen or Blocked marker. Severity: advisory generally; blocking only for that unresolved executable-plan case. Exempt: ideas, ADRs, decision comparisons, and explicitly blocked discovery.
- Imperative saturation — Signal: MUST/ALWAYS/NEVER directives exceed 1 per 10 nonblank lines or 15 total. Threshold: either. Severity: advisory only. Exempt: safety, compliance, or irreversible-operation constraints that state a reason.
- Length envelope — Signal: size exceeds the versioned P95 for accepted artifacts in the same type/complexity bucket (minimum sample 200); fallback is 8,000 description characters, 600 plan words, or 150 comment words. Threshold: one breach. Severity: advisory only; a separate operational context-window limit may reject admission but does not prove verbosity. Exempt: marked exact evidence, security/incident/legal records, and generated specifications, with overflow linked.
- Canonical-source copying — Signal: a linked local source and at least 100 copied words have 7-shingle containment of at least 0.50. Threshold: one block. Severity: advisory. Exempt: a version-pinned normative excerpt whose exact wording is itself evidence.

Apply a completeness floor before these checks; never auto-delete flagged prose or protected facts.
